title: Transport a relation through an explicit conversion
obstacle: The input and target use different representations of the same intended objects.
procedure: State the source and destination types and the conversion explicitly.
Prove that this conversion preserves the particular relation needed by the target.
Apply the resulting bridge or congruence lemma at the exact target type.
verification: Check the bridge and its application in Lean; verify that no converse or injectivity was assumed.
positive_example: Transport an equality through a specified function using congruence.
negative_example: Infer equality of original objects from equal images without injectivity.

evidence.note: Editorially generalized guidance under this maintenance policy; no independent effectiveness result or proof acceptance is claimed.
